purpose: Define each configured MCP server/endpoint under `#MCP` as an explicit logical identity separate from transport address, process identity, advertised tools and runtime connection state.

topics.name: MCP Endpoint Identity
topics.purpose: Define each configured MCP server/endpoint under `#MCP` as an explicit logical identity separate from transport address, process identity, advertised tools and runtime connection state.

semantics.identity_rule: Each configured MCP endpoint has a stable logical identity.
semantics.transport_rule: URL/socket/process/transport binding is configuration, not endpoint semantic identity.
semantics.connection_rule: configured, reachable, connected and failed states remain distinct.
semantics.capability_rule: Advertised capabilities are child observations of the endpoint and do not become endpoint identity.
semantics.tool_rule: An MCP-advertised tool is not automatically a validated `#T` tool.
semantics.authority_rule: Endpoint reachability does not grant invocation or target authority.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Reconnect/restart preserves logical endpoint identity unless explicitly replaced.

invariants.rule: MCP endpoint identity, advertised capability, validated #T tool identity, concrete invocation and returned result are separate identities; advertisement or availability never grants execution authority.

hard_gates.condition: transport address used as endpoint identity
runtime process id becomes endpoint identity
